items.text: Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is on IR and out for the season or close to it; Tanner McKee starts. The schedule data still listed Hurts, so the model uses McKee.

Saquon Barkley (hamstring) returned to practice Thursday; WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert and OLB Nolan Smith Jr. (concussion) were not seen. Official Eagles report pending; refresh Saturday/Monday.
Dallas KR/WR KaVontae Turpin (ribs) is unlikely to play and LB Dee Winters (Achilles) is likely out; LB DeMarvion Overshown and CB Cobie Durant are trending toward returning.
